modules.title: Introduction to Matrices and Determinants
modules.html:
Matrix operations, inverses and solving simultaneous equations. This section covers introduction to matrices and determinants.

Key points

  • If matrices $$A$$ and $$B$$ are inverse to each other, then $$AB =$$ — $$I$$.

Worked examples

Q: If matrices $$A$$ and $$B$$ are inverse to each other, then $$AB =$$ ?
A: $$I$$ — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: $$I$$.

Q: Find the unit vector parallel to $$ \mathbf{a} = 3\mathbf{i} - 4\mathbf{j} $$.
A: $$ 0.6\mathbf{i} - 0.8\mathbf{j} $$ — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: $$ 0.6\mathbf{i} - 0.8\mathbf{j} $$.

More key points

  • If matrices $$A$$ and $$B$$ are inverse to each other, then $$AB =$$ — $$I$$.
